description: This file declares external functions and structures related to Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) system extensions, including license management, secure stop handling, hash retrieval, and session management.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_ldl_session_limit
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of concurrent limited duration licenses (LDLs) allowed for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_is_secure_stop_enabled
methods.description: Checks if Secure Stop feature is enabled.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_enable_secure_stop
methods.description: Enables or disables Secure Stop feature.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_get_key_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: opencdm_get_secure_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the secure store.

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_drm_header
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_get_challenge_data
methods.description: Obtains challenge data for a session, in two steps.

methods.name: opencdm_session_store_license_data
methods.description: Stores license data for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_select_key_id
methods.description: Initializes decryption context with a key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_session_clean_decrypt_context
methods.description: Deinitializes the decryption context of a session.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves play levels properties from JSON.
